title: Anker 621 MagGo Power Bank 5,000mAh Magnetic Charger $33.18 (RRP $69.99) + Delivery ($0 Prime/$59 Spend) @ Anker via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Anker 621 MagGo Power Bank 5,000mAh Magnetic Charger $33.18 (RRP $69.99) + Delivery ($0 Prime/$59 Spend) @ Anker via Amazon AU

[AsukaST] Thanks. That is really heavy for a 5000mah.
I would expect something under 95g.
[djmm] They have ultra slim model but costs more
[AsukaST] I don't need wireless.
Because wireless is inefficient and kind of meaningless for such a small 5000mah power bank.
I just want something that is not heavy + fast charging,
Bunnings $7 one is an option , but it's only 10W, really slow.
I would like something 18W+.
When there is next round of 35% cashback, I am planning to get this 22.5W Battery Charger Case , and 2x21700 batteries .
Reading from reviews, the battery actual capacity is 49xx mah. In contrast, most power bank are just 60% of 5000mah = 3000 mah.
Cost after cashback and coupons for 1 battery (when buying 2) + case would be $7.45 USD = $10.70 AUD.
The case is 50g and 1x21700 battery is 70g = 120g.
I like how it let me swap the battery any time, and charges 2 devices at the same time.
[anarky] Ultra slim is still 122 grams. The Nano is their lightest at 96 grams. I have one of those and probably a better choice than this (MagGo) if intended as a backup.
[fridgejam] Is it CCC certified? If not there's a good chance you will loose it when going through airport security, especially in China (as just happened to me).
[eecan] Other countries don't care about the CCC certification, its a China specific requirement.
[RichardL] These are also 'slow' wireless and wired charging.
7.5W Wireless Charge
12W USB-C Charging and Recharging.
[kingarthur] Painfully slow and hot. Wireless charger is technically unusable if you wonder.
[HappyBargainer] it's better to buy a regular powerbank by using wired charging. I have several magsafe powerbanks but always end up using wired charging during my trip as it's quicker. Especially if you travel to a country with warm weather, wireless charging can become very slow due to the heat.
